components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits; the result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. The E.164 string (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The effective date must fall on a business day: if it lands on
            a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the following Monday, and
            that adjusted date is what is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only opt-in flag for create. When true it allows creating an
            owner that shares a household (same lastName and address, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) with an existing owner;
            otherwise such a create is rejected 409. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city,
                LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create
                (one more than the number of owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same
                household (same lastName and address, compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace). Assigned on create when the request
                sets sharesHousehold true: all owners sharing the household
                receive the same value. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'e6b1c2d4-0f3a-4b8c-9d2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0
                and an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'. Derived on read.
              type: string
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

Implemented the `bulkSignupWarning` rule for `POST /api/owners`: when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the new owner's registration date, the flag is `true`; otherwise `false`. It's assigned at create time (matching the daily-limit rule's per-day accumulation), persisted, and returned on read.

Changes:

1. **New function** `AssignBulkSignupWarning.java` — counts existing owners sharing the resolved registration date and sets `bulkSignupWarning = count > 80`. Runs before save, so the count excludes the owner being created (same convention as `EnsureDailyRegistrationLimit`, `AssignNamesakeCount`, etc.).

2. **Pipeline wiring** in `owners.POST.yml` — inserted the `assignBulkSignupWarning` step (under `govern: [ transaction ]`) between `assignMembershipNumber` and `save`.

3. **`Owner` entity** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` `Boolean` field mapped to a new `bulk_signup_warning` column, plus getter/setter.

4. **DB schemas** — added `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN` to all four (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`); the tests run on `hsqldb`.

5. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct maps it by name.

6. **`OwnerMapper`** — added `@Mapping(target = "bulkSignupWarning", ignore = true)` on `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (it's a computed/response-only field, following the `namesakeCount`/`membershipNumber` pattern).

The persisted approach means the value the create computed is exactly what `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns, which is what `AcceptanceTest.coreNoBulkWarningUnderThreshold` asserts.
